topic: Asking the Billing Desk to Set Up a Payment Plan

script.title: THE BIG HOSPITAL BILL
script.scene_zh: 醫院賬務台 · 商量分期
script.story_hook: The hospital bill arrived, and it had teeth.
script.intro_zh: 醫院賬單寄到了，還齜著牙。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we face a hospital bill. Listen for money and plan phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天我們一起面對醫院賬單。留意談錢與分期方案的說法。
script.outro: And that's a scary bill, now friendly. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 嚇人的賬單就這樣變友善了。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: It says eight hundred and forty dollars
script.char_a_description: a woman in her sixties with short curly silver hair, gold hoop earrings, a burgundy quilted jacket over a cream turtleneck, a small shoulder purse, and a plump build
script.char_b_description: a young man in his mid twenties with a shaved head and a neat thin beard, a hospital-navy polo shirt, a plastic ID badge on a lanyard, and a tall wiry build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. I have a question about this bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˌæftɚˈnun aɪ hæv ə ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðɪs bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 下午好。我有一張賬單想請教一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi, sure thing. May I have the account number?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈʃʊɹ θɪŋ meɪ aɪ hæv ði əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，沒問題。請問帳戶編號是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, it's on the top corner here. Nine, two, two...
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ɪts ɑn ðə tɑp ˈkɔɹnɚ hɪɹ naɪn tu tu/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，就在最上面這裡。九、二、二⋯⋯

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. So, Anita, what's troubling you here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt soʊ əˈnitə wæts ˈtrʌbəlɪŋ ju hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那麼，Anita，這張賬單卡在哪裡了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, it says eight hundred and forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪt sɛz eɪt ˈhʌndrəd ænd ˈfɔɹti ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著八百四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's a big number to get by mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðæts ə bɪɡ ˈnʌmbɚ tə ɡɛt baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這種數字的信突然寄到家，確實嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I opened it during lunch and nearly dropped it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ oʊˈpɛnd ɪt ˈdɜɹɪŋ lʌntʃ ænd ˈnɪɹli dɹɑpt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我午餐時拆開它，差點沒拿穩掉到地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I understand, truly. Do you have the itemized page?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndɚˈstænd ˈtɹuli du ju hæv ði ˈaɪtəmˌsaɪzd peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，真的。你有明細那一頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The what? Sorry, my English did the deaf thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌt ˈsɑɹi maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ dɪd ðə dɛf θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 什麼頁？抱歉，我的英文耳朵剛剛裝聾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, the second page, the one listing each charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈsɛkənd peɪdʒ ðə wʌn ˈlɪstɪŋ itʃ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，就是第二頁，一項一項列費用的那頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! This crumpled paper? I thought it was waste.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɪs ˈkɹʌmpəld ˈpeɪpɚ aɪ θɔt ɪt wəz weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 噢！這張皺巴巴的紙？我還以為是廢紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That treasure tells the whole story. Let's read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtɹɛʒɚ tɛlz ðə hoʊl ˈstɔɹi lɛts ɹid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那可是寶貝，整個故事都在上面。我們來讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, room fee, supplies, and... a blood test?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ rum fi səˈplaɪz ænd ə blʌd tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 好，病房費、耗材，還有⋯⋯抽血檢查？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any test surprises there? Twice, for instance?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tɛst sɚˈpɹaɪzəz ðɛɹ twaɪs fɔɹ ˈɪnstəns/
dialogue.zh: 檢查那欄有驚喜嗎？例如同一項算了兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Two blood tests, but I remember one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu blʌd tɛsts bət aɪ ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 有！兩次抽血，可我只記得一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me compare with the doctor's notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm lɛt mi kəmˈpɛɹ wɪð ðə ˈdɑktɚz nots/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我對照一下醫師的記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. It was such a long morning that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ɪt wəz sʌtʃ ə lɔŋ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。那天早上真的特別漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right, one visit, one test. This one's fixable.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɹaɪt wʌn ˈvɪzɪt wʌn tɛst wʌnz ˈfɪksəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，一次就診、一次檢查。這筆能修正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh thank goodness. Does that mean the bill shrinks?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs dʌz ðæt min ðə bɪl ʃɹɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 噢，謝天謝地。那賬單會縮水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should drop by about two hundred, I'd say.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd dɹɑp baɪ əˈbaʊt tu ˈhʌndrəd aɪd seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 應該會減掉兩百塊上下，我估的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief, though it's still a mouthful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə rɪˈlif ðoʊ ɪts stɪl ə ˈmaʊtfʊl/
dialogue.zh: 鬆了口氣，不過剩下的數目還是很大一坨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fair. Any insurance on file for this visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli fɛɹ ˈɛni ɪnˈʃʊɹəns ɑn faɪl fɚ ðɪs ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完全合理。這次就診有登記保險嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have the basics, but the coverage is thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə ˈbeɪsɪks bət ðə ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ɪz θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 有基本險，但給付的範圍很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin coverage, got it. So what's left after insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ɡɑɾ ɪt soʊ wæts lɛft ˈæftɚ ɪnˈʃʊɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 範圍很薄，了解了。那保險之後還剩多少要自付？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The deductible ate most of it, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈdʌktəbəl eɪt moʊst əv ɪt ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 免賠額吃掉了大半，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then here's the good news. You're not stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪɹz ðə ɡʊd njuːz jʊɹ nɑt stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 那有個好消息：你不會困在原地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stuck? What do you mean, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /stʌk wət du ju min ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 困在原地？你說的是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can split this into a monthly payment plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən splɪt ðɪs ˈɪntə ə ˈmʌnθli ˈpeɪmənt plæn/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把它攤成按月償還的計劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A plan, um, is that like borrowing from you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə plæn ʌm ɪz ðæt laɪk ˈbɑɹoʊɪŋ fɹəm ju/
dialogue.zh: 計劃？嗯，那等於是向醫院借錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not borrowing, just paying in smaller pieces.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈbɑɹoʊɪŋ dʒʌst ˈpeɪɪŋ ɪn ˈsmɔlɚ ˈpisəz/
dialogue.zh: 不是借錢，只是把大數字拆成小塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now that sounds kinder to my wallet, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðət ˈsaʊndz ˈkaɪndɚ tə maɪ ˈwɑlət hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣聽起來，我的錢包會開心多了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. Thirty a month, if the total's six forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈθɜɾdi ə mʌnθ ɪf ðə ˈtoʊɾəlz sɪks ˈfɔɾti/
dialogue.zh: 是呀。總額六百四十的話，一個月三十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty monthly, I could arrange that easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɾdi ˈmʌnθli aɪ kʊd əˈreɪndʒ ðæt ˈiləzli/
dialogue.zh: 一個月三十，我排得進去，不費力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And there's zero interest on these plans.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɛɹz ˈzɪɹoʊ ˈɪntrəst ɑn ðiz plænz/
dialogue.zh: 而且這類分期計劃完全不計利息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zero? No hidden fees hiding in the fine print?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪɹoʊ noʊ ˈhɪdən fiz ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə faɪn prɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 零利息？小字裡面沒有藏起來的費用吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean plan, written promise, right on my desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin plæn ˈɹɪtn ˈpɹɑməs ɹaɪt ɑn maɪ dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 乾乾淨淨的計劃，白紙黑字寫在我桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, sign me up then, gladly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl saɪn mi ʌp ðɛn ˈɡlædli/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就麻煩幫我登記一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to. Should it come out of your bank account?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə ʃʊd ɪt kʊm aʊt əv jɔɹ bæŋk əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 開心。從你的銀行賬戶直接扣款好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, automatic, so my forgetful self relaxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˌædəˈmætɪk soʊ maɪ fɚˈɡɛtfəl sɛlf ɹɪˈlæksəz/
dialogue.zh: 要，自動扣款，我這種愛忘事的人就輕鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best habit. The first payment pulls next Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈhæbəɪt ðə fɝst ˈpeɪmənt pʊls nɛks ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 最好的習慣。第一期款下週五扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday's payday, the stars align a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪz ˈpeɪˌdeɪ ðə stɑɹz əˈlaɪn ə ˈlɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 週五正好是發薪日，星星都往我這邊靠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, sometimes they do. One more important thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ði du wʌn mɔɹ ɪmˈpɔɹtənt θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，偶爾真會這樣。還有一件重要的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh, what did I miss this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ oʊ wət dɪd aɪ mɪs ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這次我又漏掉了什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just remember, missed plan payments still cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ mɪst plæn ˈpeɪmənts stɪl kɑst/
dialogue.zh: 只是記得，分期付款一旦遲了，還是會產生費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I'll mark my calendar in red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪl mɑɹk maɪ ˈkæləndɚ ɪn ɹɛd/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我要把行事曆標成大紅字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll mail the plan to your home address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪl meɪl ðə plæn tə jɔɹ hoʊm əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 完美。我會把計劃書用郵件寄到你家地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same one as the envelope, please double-check it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wʌn æz ði ˈɛnvəloʊ pliz ˈdʌbəlˌtʃɛk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 和信封上那個一樣，麻煩再核對一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It usually lands in five days, keep an eye out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈjuʒəwəli lændz ɪn faɪv deɪz kip æn aɪ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 通常五天內會送到，記得留意信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Can I also ask about payment receipts?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ æsk əˈbaʊt ˈpeɪmənt rɪˈsits/
dialogue.zh: 好的。我也想問問每期繳款收據的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each payment sends you a receipt, email or paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ ˈpeɪmənt sɛndz ju ə rɪˈsit ˈimeɪl ɔɹ ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 每期繳款都會附一張收據，電子郵件或紙本都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email suits me, my files live in one folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl suts mi maɪ faɪlz lɪv ɪn wʌn ˈfoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 郵件最適合我，我的文件都住在同一個資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, done. And how are you feeling these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dʌn ænd haʊ ɑɹ ju ˈfilɪŋ ðiz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 搞定，搞定。順帶問問，你最近身體感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stronger, though the stairs and I still argue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɔɹŋɡɚ ðoʊ ðə stɛɹz ænd aɪ stɪl ˈɑɹɡju/
dialogue.zh: 好多了，不過我和樓梯每天還是要鬥嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, stairs win at first. Give it a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ stɛɹz wɪn æt fɝst ɡɪv ɪt ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，開頭總是樓梯贏。給自己一個月時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the plan, literally, ha ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plæn ˈlɪtəɹəli hɑ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 這才是真的『有計劃』了，哈哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set, Anita. Anything else I can do?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɔl sɛt əˈnitə ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls aɪ kən du/
dialogue.zh: 一切就緒囉，Anita。還有什麼是我也能幫上的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, you turned a scary letter into paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju tɝnd ə ˈskɛɹi ˈlɛɾɚ ˈɪntə ˈpeɪpɚˌwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，你把一封嚇人的信，變成規規矩矩的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my favorite trick, small and boring ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈfeɪvɹət trɪk smɔl ænd ˈbɔɹɪŋ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 這是我最拿手的小魔術，又小又無聊的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small is wonderful after a morning like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ɪz ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈæfˌtɚ ə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 經歷那樣一上午，小小的一件事也顯得美好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take care, Anita, and be gentle with stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk kɛɹ əˈnitə ænd bi ˈdʒɛntəl wɪð stɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 多保重，Anita，對待樓梯客氣一點。

script.youtube_title: 【醫院賬單嚇死人💸】「上面寫著八百四十美元」零利息分期怎麼談🧾📞🤝｜聽完就會自己打去問｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Hospital Bill Payment Plan
script.youtube_title_en: "Eight Hundred and Forty Dollars" — Turning a Hospital Bill into a Fair Plan
script.youtube_description:
「上面寫著八百四十美元」——醫院的信從來不請自來，這一集教你走到賬務台，把嚇人的賬單一件件問清楚。

你會聽到：報出賬單編號開始質問；找到費用明細頁、揪出重複計費的抽血檢查；保險給付太薄時如何自處；零利息分期計劃的完整問法，一個月三十塊的數學；自動扣款、遲繳費用、收件地址與每期收據的安排。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，反覆出現的是美國人講錢時的真實語感：um、well、so、oh、right。聽完你就會用：I have a question about this bill、Do you have the itemized page?、We can split this into a monthly payment plan。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It says eight hundred and forty dollars" — hospital letters never ask permission before arriving. In this episode you walk up to the billing desk and take the scary bill apart, charge by charge.

You will hear: giving your account number and stating the problem; finding the itemized page and catching a blood test billed twice; what to say when insurance coverage runs thin; the full script for a zero-interest monthly plan, thirty at a time; and auto-pay, late fees, mailing addresses and receipts.

Everything stays at A2 level, ten words or fewer per line, with the fillers Americans use when money talk gets awkward: um, well, so, oh, right. By the end you'll own lines like I have a question about this bill and We can split this into a monthly payment plan.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
